title: Odd-size frequency family
statement: For natural numbers $n,m$ and an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the odd-size frequency family is the union of the low-degree Fourier family with parameters $n,m$ and the family obtained by adjoining $i$ to each $m$-element subset of the other indices.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definition of the low-degree Fourier family, so its precise meaning cannot be verified here.
